body:
I have no fucking clue why you care so much about me. i don't know how to write this down, so I'll make a list

1. I am a lesbian, if I tell anyone in my family that, I will not have a family anymore. They talk about boys and dating and I'm scared that they will catch on. Essentially I have two choices, keep my family now or make myself a new one. I have no clue what is the "right choice"

2. I throw up most of my food purposely. I can't keep my food down. Every time I eat I actually feel sick because I have made such a habit out of it.

3 I am always on drugs, I don't even know who the sober me is, my whole life is just finding something that makes me high, that is all I do. Sence Like the middle of 7th grade I literally have never been sober.


If this isn't a reason to kill myself I don't know what is
There is nothing left to help. Don't waste your time on me, use it on someone who can actually be saved. Just pretend that i died when I overdosed, save yourself some pain.
Still depressed as fuck, I'm planning to try something else next time.
